results.name: Optional Studio mode starts without a source/backend and preserves the Viewer default
Open, brush, undo and mode-switch commands target Studio and keep its source/mask session
Desktop broker connects only on action and the explicit validation run yields a preview
Narrow layout and light theme expose the canvas, prompt, setup and variant actions
Portable Studio project contains checksummed binary artifacts; Ctrl+S exports only selected variant
Cancel survives mode changes, ignores late backend results and never interrupts other jobs
Explicit acceptance opens a new photo with source, seed and workflow provenance
Reload restores a durable Studio session with its mask, variants and independent activation
